name: simple-calculator
description: A simple calculator application - console and web versions

scripts.serve: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let filePath = '.' + (req.url === '/' ? '/index.html' : req.url); const ext = path.extname(filePath); const mimeTypes = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.css': 'text/css', '.json': 'application/json' }; res.setHeader('Content-Type', mimeTypes[ext] || 'text/plain'); fs.readFile(filePath, (err, content) => { if (err) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('File not found'); } else { res.writeHead(200); res.end(content); } }); }); server.listen(3000, () => console.log('Server running at http://localhost:3000'));"
